text: {"lessons":["My account has grown overall, but month-to-month changes can be uneven; I should prioritize preserving savings needed for retirement over chasing returns.","Selling some shares of A and C at a gain realized profits, but a past gain does not tell me what their prices will do next; I should decide based on my needs and risk tolerance.","I have often done well by avoiding frequent trades, so I should review my holdings calmly and trade only when there is a clear reason."]}
